scholarships.title: Bolsas Doutorado Sanduiche no Exterior - Edital Comite Gestor Fiocruz no 01/2026 (CAPES-Global.Edu)

existing.description: The Managing Committee of Fiocruz, which sits on the CAPES Global Network for Sustainable Development, Science and Health, runs a public call to select candidates for sandwich-doctorate scholarships abroad under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme (CAPES Edital no 13/2025). The scholarship funds a research stay at a foreign higher education institution for doctoral students of Fundacao Oswaldo Cruz, who return to Brazil within the CAPES deadline to complete and defend their thesis. Only doctoral students of Fiocruz graduate programmes that belong to the CAPES Global network and are linked to its strategic themes may apply, and each candidate may register for only one of the five Fiocruz editais.
eligibility: Be a doctoral student (discente de doutorado) registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform
Be enrolled in a Fiocruz graduate programme that belongs to the Rede CAPES Global para o Desenvolvimento Sustentavel, Ciencia e Saude
Be linked to the strategic themes of that network, as set out in Annex I of the call
Register for only one of the five editais published by the Fiocruz Managing Committee; candidates who register more than once have all registrations automatically cancelled
existing.eligibility_summary: Doctoral students duly registered on the CAPES Sucupira platform as students of a Fiocruz graduate programme that is part of the CAPES Global network for Sustainable Development, Science and Health and is linked to the network's strategic themes (Annex I).
benefits: Research placement abroad (estagio para o desenvolvimento de pesquisa) at a foreign higher education institution
Overseas activities starting in September and October 2027
coverage: Sandwich-doctorate research placement at a foreign higher education institution
Return to Brazil within the CAPES regulatory deadline to complete and defend the thesis
requirements: Submit the proposal exclusively through the electronic application form published on the call page
First-time users of the Fiocruz site must register before applying
Accept the conditions of the Edital
documents: Anexo I - Temas Estrategicos CG Fiocruz
Anexo II - Plano de Atividade DSE
Anexo III - Qualificacao de parceria internacional
Anexo IV - Carta de indicacao do Programa de Pos-graduacao
Anexo V - Carta de aceite da instituicao de ensino superior no exterior
Anexo VI - Declaracao de fluencia linguistica do orientador no exterior
Anexo VII - Declaracao de fluencia linguistica do orientador no Brasil
application_method: Online application form on the Fiocruz Campus Virtual editais platform
existing.selection_notes: Results and any appeals are published exclusively on this page, following the schedule in the call. The call page does not publish selection criteria, weighting or financial values.
existing.best_fit: Doctoral candidates already enrolled in a Fiocruz graduate programme that belongs to the CAPES Global network, who need a period of research training abroad to finish a doctoral thesis.
existing.notes: The monetary terms of this award (monthly stipend, airfare, insurance) are set by CAPES Edital no 13/2025 and are not reproduced on the Fiocruz call page, so no funding amount is claimed here.
existing.application_period: 15/09/2026 to 23/10/2026 (16h, Brasilia time); overseas activities begin September and October 2027
existing.deadline_display: Applications close 23 October 2026 at 16:00 Brasilia time
existing.program_type: Research institute doctoral mobility scholarship administered under the CAPES-Global.Edu programme
